name: Bootyhole
description: Bootyhole: a small private-use Kasm workspace registry (generic workspace definitions only).

workspaces.description: Debian is a Linux distribution composed of free and open-source software, developed by the community-supported Debian Project PREBUILT OFFICIAL KASM IMAGE for the same distribution as the owner's ISO debian-live-12.5.0-amd64-cinnamon.iso (Debian 12). It is not built from, extracted from or equivalent to that ISO: shared host kernel, no installer/bootloader/live-boot.
workspaces.notes:
The Kasm Debian Bookworm Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run Debian Bookworm but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.

workspaces.description: Kali Linux is a Debian-derived Linux distribution designed for digital forensics and penetration testing. PREBUILT OFFICIAL KASM IMAGE for the same distribution as the owner's ISO kali-linux-2024.1-live-amd64.iso (Kali; this image is the current rolling release, not 2024.1). It is not built from, extracted from or equivalent to that ISO: shared host kernel, no installer/bootloader/live-boot.
workspaces.notes:
The Kasm Kali Linux Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run Kali Linux but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by configuring the Docker Run Config Override and Docker Exec Config (JSON) settings above according to the instructions in this article: https://kasmweb.atlassian.net/wiki/x/DgDHMg

NOTE: This will run the Workspace with runtime security modifications and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.
